title: A student from my group joins Kyushu University on the JST LOTUS (Basic) Program.
body: Selected by the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST), the student opens a research collaboration with Kyushu University, extending the India and Japan research ties that began during my years at Keio.

title: Session Chair, IEEE EMBC 2026, Toronto
body: Chairing a session at the 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society, where two of my papers also appear.

title: IEEE ComSoc Travel Grant for ICC 2026, Glasgow
body: Awarded USD 1,930 to present our work on non-invasive fetal ECG extraction using deep learning and earth mover's distance.

title: Shinkai Labs Drone Detection and Tracking Platform registered
body: Granted by the Copyright Office, Government of India.

title: Seven conference papers accepted
body: At IEEE EMBC (two), IEEE ICC, IEEE CICN, IEEE SPACE, CVIP and ICETCI: fetal ECG, few-shot medical anomaly detection, topology-preserving segmentation and radar tracking.
